review_cost.rationale: Approve after a round of small, localized changes: relocate team cookie logic, harden the cache and static root, and add a few API-shape types. Nothing structural needs rework.

findings.issue: Cookie persistence and Hono Context handling live in the views layer, making the render module depend on server concerns (and forcing index.tsx to import five team functions from views/)
findings.suggestion: Move readTeam/writeTeam/addToTeam/removeFromTeam/loadTeam into a src/team.ts (or src/team.tsx if components stay) module; views/team.tsx keeps only TeamButton/TeamContent/TeamPage

findings.issue: Module-level cache Map with no size cap or eviction policy; growth is bounded only by the API dataset (pokemon records are large), and it survives forever in a long-running server
findings.suggestion: Add an LRU/size cap or an explicit statement that the dataset is fixed, and consider aborting entries when the backing fetch fails repeatedly

findings.issue: serveStatic({ root: './dist' }) resolves against process.cwd(), so starting the server from another directory silently breaks all static assets
findings.suggestion: Derive the root from import.meta.dirname (e.g. new URL('./dist', import.meta.url)) so it is start-directory-independent

findings.issue: Upstream fetch has no timeout/AbortSignal; a hung API request stalls the page indefinitely and onError never fires
findings.suggestion: Pass AbortSignal.timeout(...) to fetch and throw a typed error for the 500 handler

findings.issue: POST /team/add/:name persists any name to the cookie without checking it's a real species, so garbage can accumulate in user state
findings.suggestion: Validate the name against allSpecies() (or the species fetch) before writing the cookie, mirroring the null-check pattern used everywhere else

findings.issue: API responses are untyped (`any`) throughout the loaders, with inline casts (details.tsx:57, data.ts:74) that hide data-shape assumptions
findings.suggestion: Define small interfaces (Species, Pokemon, Move, TypeRecord, VersionGroup) in data.ts and type api<T>() calls; removes most casts and documents the API contract

findings.issue: addToTeam/removeFromTeam are declared async with no awaits, and the cookie read-modify-write is not atomic under concurrent htmx requests (last write wins)
findings.suggestion: Drop the unnecessary async, or document the concurrency semantics; validation (above) also bounds the blast radius

findings.issue: typesByPokemonId() rebuilds a map over every type's pokemon list (~18k entries) on every home and team request despite the underlying records being cached
findings.suggestion: Memoize the derived map alongside the cached type records, or cache it by the type-list identity

findings.issue: /pokemon/:name/moves-table returns a bare, unstyled table fragment when navigated to directly
findings.suggestion: Acceptable for an htmx-only endpoint, but returning 404 (or the full page) for non-HX requests would be more defensive

summary: A small, tidy, genuinely idiomatic Hono + htmx app on current stable versions, with best-practice details (history-restore handling, Vary, hx-sync dedup, SWR cache) that most htmx integrations miss. The main review asks are layering (team cookie logic out of views/), typing the API responses, and two robustness nits (cache cap, fetch timeout, cwd-relative static root). I'd merge after one round of small, localized changes.
